summary.name: Google AI Education
summary.one_liner: Google's hub of AI courses, training programs, and learning resources for workers, developers, leaders, and small businesses.
use_cases: Using Gemini in Google Workspace to manage email
Learning to build and deploy AI agents
summary.what_it_does: The page lists a range of Google AI learning offerings, including short video courses on generative AI basics and machine learning differences. It includes a course on using Gemini in Google Workspace to summarize emails, find information, and draft replies. Advanced options cover large language models, prompt tuning, diffusion models on Google Cloud and Vertex AI, and using Gemini in the software development lifecycle. It also mentions organizational and small-business training led by Google-authorized instructors, plus a curated set of tutorials, explainers, and demos.
notable: Gemini in Google Workspace course for inbox management

Gemini Agent Ready (GEAR) program for building AI agents
caveats: Free AI Pro offer has terms that apply
